subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Cruises: reading, vocabulary matching and crossword
outcomes: Read a text about cruises and answer comprehension questions
Match cruise words with their meanings and use them correctly

tf.s: A cruise is a holiday on a large ship.
tf.why: Cruise passengers travel and stay on a big ship.

tf.s: Cruise ships are called floating hotels because they offer luxurious accommodation at sea.
tf.why: They have comfortable rooms and services like a hotel.

tf.s: Shops and fitness centres are examples of amenities on a cruise ship.
tf.why: Amenities are useful facilities for passengers.

tf.s: 'Voyage' means a short walk in a city.
tf.why: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea.
Security keeps people and things safe.

tf.s: The 'staff' on a ship are the people who work there.
tf.why: Staff are the workers of a company or ship.

tf.s: Cruise ships do not need any maintenance.
tf.why: Big ships need maintenance to keep them working well.

tf.s: Muttrah Corniche in Muscat never receives cruise ships.
tf.why: Muttrah Corniche often welcomes cruise ships.

o: A holiday on a large ship
boxes.why: A cruise is a holiday at sea on a big ship.
A voyage is a long sea journey.

boxes.q: What are the people who work on a ship called?
Which is an amenity on a cruise ship?
boxes.why: Amenities are useful facilities like gyms and shops.

boxes.q: Which word means 'great comfort and expensive things'?
Where in Muscat do cruise ships often arrive?
boxes.why: Muttrah Corniche often welcomes cruise ships.

boxes.q: What are cruise ships often called?
boxes.why: They are like luxurious hotels on the sea.

mcq.q: Why are cruise ships called floating hotels?
o: They offer luxurious accommodation at sea
mcq.why: Like hotels, they give passengers comfortable rooms and services.

mcq.q: Which two amenities on a cruise ship are named in the reading?
mcq.why: The reading mentions shops and fitness centres.

mcq.q: Which 7-letter word means 'a journey by sea'?

o: The people who work for a company or ship

mcq.q: Choose the best word: 'The ship has guards and cameras for ___.'
mcq.why: Guards and cameras protect people from danger.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: 'The ship is ___; it carries thousands of passengers.'
mcq.why: A ship for thousands of people is very large.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: 'The food was ___; it was the best meal of my life.'
Which sentence best explains why a cruise is a popular holiday?
o: You travel to new places while enjoying hotel amenities
You must cook all your own food
You stay in one place for the whole trip
There are no staff to help you
mcq.why: A cruise combines travel with luxury and amenities.

mcq.q: Which word is the odd one out?
mcq.why: 'Voyage' is a noun; the other three are adjectives.

mcq.q: Why does a cruise ship need many staff?
o: To run its shops, rooms, meals and security for many passengers
Because passengers must work on the ship
Because the ship has no amenities
mcq.why: A floating hotel needs many workers to serve its passengers.
